azkar.text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
azkar.transliteration: asbahna wa asbaha al-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir, rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadha al-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadha al-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dahu, rabbi a'udhu bika min al-kasali wa su'il-kibar, rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabi fin-nar wa adhabi fil-qabr
azkar.translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise belongs to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good that follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness, the difficulties of old age, the punishment of the Fire, and the punishment of the grave.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut, wa ilayka an-nushur
azkar.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, fa minka wahdaka la sharika lak, falaka al-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
azkar.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have entered the morning with is from You alone, without partner. So to You belongs all praise and all thanks.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma afini fi badani, allahumma afini fi sam'i, allahumma afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant, allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min adhabi al-qabr, la ilaha illa ant
azkar.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu hamalata arshik, wa mala'ikatak, wa jami'a khalqik, annaka anta Allah la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna muhammadan abduka wa rasuluk
azkar.translation: O Allah, this morning I call upon You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation to bear witness that You are Allah. There is no god but You, alone without partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ، وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ، وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا، وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyu al-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi-shay'in min ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-aliyyul-azim
azkar.translation: Allah—there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne encompasses the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.

azkar.text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
azkar.transliteration: qul huwa Allahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
azkar.translation: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there anyone comparable to Him.

azkar.text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
azkar.transliteration: qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
azkar.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

azkar.text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَهِ النَّاسِ، مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ، الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ، مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
azkar.transliteration: qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril-waswasil-khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas, minal-jinnati wan-nas
azkar.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fil-ard wa la fis-sama, wa huwas-sami'ul-alim
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih
azkar.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything. I testify that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of Satan and his incitement to associate partners with You.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa amalan mutaqabbalan
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good and lawful provision, and accepted deeds.

azkar.text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
azkar.virtue: ورد عن أبي الدرداء رضي الله عنه
azkar.transliteration: hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa rabbul-arshil-azim
azkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
azkar.virtue: ورد في فضل قوله صباحًا ومساءً
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ajirni min an-nar
azkar.translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali, allahummastur awrati, wa amin rawati, wahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi, wa an yamini wa an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi-azamatika an ughtala min tahti
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. Protect me from before me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your greatness from being unexpectedly harmed from beneath me.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
azkar.transliteration: allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa, wal-afafa wal-ghina
azkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

azkar.text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
azkar.transliteration: ya hayyu ya qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li shani kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn
azkar.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Set all my affairs right for me, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
azkar.transliteration: subhanallahi wa bihamdih
azkar.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

azkar.text: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
azkar.transliteration: subhanallahi wa bihamdih, adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata arshih, wa midada kalimatih
azkar.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah, as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as heavy as His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ighfir li dhanbi kullah, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa alaniyatahu wa sirrah
azkar.translation: O Allah, forgive all my sins: the small and the great, the first and the last, the apparent and the hidden.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ajalni min at-tawwabin, wajalni min al-mutatahhirin
azkar.translation: O Allah, make me among those who constantly repent and among those who purify themselves.

azkar.text: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
azkar.transliteration: rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin, wa a'udhu bika rabbi an yahdurun
azkar.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their presence.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي وَأَهْلِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ، وَاكْفِنَا بِحِفْظِكَ وَرِعَايَتِكَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ihfazni wa ahli wa dhurriyyati min kulli su', wakfina bi-hifzika wa ri'ayatika
azkar.translation: O Allah, protect me, my family, and my offspring from every evil, and suffice us through Your protection and care.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma ikfini bi-halalika an haramik, wa aghnini bi-fadlika amman siwak
azkar.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace so that I need no one besides You.

azkar.text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
azkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
azkar.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is capable of all things.

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
azkar.transliteration: a'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
azkar.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fil-ard wa la fis-sama, wa huwas-sami'ul-alim
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
azkar.transliteration: allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik ala nabiyyina muhammad
azkar.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings, peace, and grace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

azkar.text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
azkar.transliteration: rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, wa fil-akhirati hasanatan, wa qina adhaban-nar
azkar.translation: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
